get.summary: Retrieve account addresses by account code
get.description:
Retrieves a list of addresses associated with the specified account, identified by the account code. Addresses are returned based on any applied filter, sort, and pagination criteria. If the account code is invalid or does not exist, the API returns an error. If a valid filter yields no matching addresses for the given account, the response is 204 No Content.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| AddressId | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |

**Example:**
- `filter=AddressId~gt~142`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj).

---

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| Address1 | Sort by the first address line. |
| Address2 | Sort by the second address line. |
| Address3 | Sort by the third address line. |
| AddressId | Sort by the address identifier. |
| CityName | Sort by the city name. |
| CompanyName | Sort by the company name. |
| CountryName | Sort by the country name. |
| DisplayName | Sort by the display name. |
| FirstName | Sort by the first name. |
| LastName | Sort by the last name. |
| PhoneNumber | Sort by the phone number. |
| PostalCode | Sort by the postal code. |
| StateName | Sort by the state name. |

**Example:**
- `sort=LastName~asc`

---

### Related APIs

- **`GET`** [Retrieve all account addresses](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/62a0v3z9fxqta)
- **`POST`** [Create a new address associated with the specified account](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/r4io4mnnlobza)
- **`PUT`** [Update a Account Address](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/a48g09vbs90cx)

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Collection of filter conditions to narrow down the result set. Multiple filters are combined with AND logic. Format: `filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`. For complete filter syntax, supported operators, pagination, and sorting usage, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sorting configuration for the result set. Supports ascending and descending order. Format: `sort={field}~{asc|desc}`. For complete filter syntax, supported operators, pagination, and sorting usage, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj).

get.summary: List all account departments
get.description:
Retrieves a list of all departments associated with accounts in the system. Each entry includes the department name and the account it belongs to. Supports filtering, sorting, and pagination for flexible retrieval of results.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| DepartmentId | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| DepartmentName | cn (Contains), ew (EndsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike), sw (StartsWith) |
| AccountId | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| CreatedDate | eq (Equals), nlk (NotLike) |
| ModifiedDate | eq (Equals), nlk (NotLike) |

**Example:**
- `filter=DepartmentName~cn~Engineering`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

---

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| DepartmentId | Sort by the department identifier. |
| DepartmentName | Sort by the department name. |

**Example:**
- `sort=DepartmentId~asc`

---

get.summary: List orders for a specific account
get.description:
Retrieves a list of orders for the specified account, identified by its account code. Supports filtering, sorting, and pagination for flexible retrieval of results.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| OrderNumber | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| OrderDate | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| UserId | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |

**Example:**
- `filter=OrderNumber~cn~"ORD-2024"`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

---

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| OrderDate | Sort by the order date. |
| OrderId | Sort by the order identifier. |
| OrderNumber | Sort by the order number. |
| OrderStatusCode | Sort by the order status code. |
| UserId | Sort by the user identifier. |

**Example:**
- `sort=OrderDate~desc`

---

### Expand Support

Specifies which additional related resources to include in the response. Multiple values can be specified by repeating the parameter (e.g. `expand=Value1&expand=Value2`).

**Supported Expand Values:**

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| Details | Includes detailed order line items, product information, and shipping details for each order in the response. |

**Allowed values:** `Details`

**Example:**
- `["Details"]`

---

### Related APIs

- **`GET`** [Get account details by account code](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/59i02a3wq7jab)
- **`PUT`** [Update customer order address](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/ll3cqd7pfzxyx)

get.summary: List child accounts for a specific parent account
get.description:
Retrieves a list of child accounts associated with the specified parent account. Supports filtering, sorting, and pagination for flexible retrieval of results.

---

### IDOR Validation and User-Based Data Access Behavior

This API enforces access ownership validation when the **EnableJwtOwnershipValidation** flag is enabled. This flag is disabled by default and is not configurable from the Admin interface. To enable it, the flag must be explicitly set to `true` in the tenant-specific configuration.

When enabled:
- Users can access and manage only the child accounts associated with their own account.
- Any attempt to access accounts belonging to another user is identified as an ownership violation and results in a **403 Forbidden** response.
- Administrative access is limited to the scope of the associated account.
- Access for managers is restricted according to their assigned permissions and ownership rules.
- Guest user access is restricted.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| Name | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), lk (Like), ne (NotEquals) |
| AccountCode | cn (Contains), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith) |
| AccountId | in (In) |

**Example:**
- `filter=Name~cn~Acme`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

---

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| Name | Sort by account name. |

**Example:**
- `sort=Name~asc`

---

### Expand Support

Specifies which additional related resources to include in the response. Multiple values can be specified by repeating the parameter (e.g. `expand=Value1&expand=Value2`).

**Supported Expand Values:**

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| Addresses | Includes the associated address details for each child account in the response. |

**Allowed values:** `Addresses`

**Example:**
- `["Addresses"]`

get.summary: List all account addresses.
get.description:
Retrieves a list of all addresses associated with accounts. Supports filtering, sorting, and pagination for flexible retrieval of results.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| AccountAddressId | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| AccountId | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| AddressId | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| CreatedBy | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| CreatedDate | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| ModifiedBy | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| ModifiedDate | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |

**Example:**
- `filter=AccountAddressId~gt~142`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

---

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| AccountAddressId | Sort by the account address identifier. |
| AccountId | Sort by the account identifier. |
| AddressId | Sort by the address identifier. |
| CreatedBy | Sort by the identifier of the user who created the address. |
| CreatedDate | Sort by the creation date. |
| ModifiedBy | Sort by the identifier of the user who last modified the address. |
| ModifiedDate | Sort by the last modification date. |

**Example:**
- `sort=AccountAddressId~asc`

---

### Related APIs

- **`POST`** [Create a new address associated with the specified account](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/r4io4mnnlobza)
- **`DELETE`** [Delete one or more account addresses.](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/7mbxk9y4ts6rg)
- **`PUT`** [Update a Account Address](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/a48g09vbs90cx)
- **`GET`** [Retrieve account addresses by account code.](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/d844a9d05c753-retrieve-account-addresses-by-account-code)

get.summary: List blog and news entries for a store
get.description:
Retrieves a paginated list of blog and news entries for the specified store. Use the blogNewsType parameter to filter results by content type - either Blogs or News. Supports filtering, sorting, and pagination for flexible retrieval of results.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| BlogNewsId | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| BlogNewsTitle | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| BlogNewsType | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| CountComments | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| ActivationDate | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| ExpirationDate | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| CreatedDate | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| StoreName | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| LocaleId | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| IsAllowGuestComment | is (Is) |
| IsBlogNewsActive | is (Is) |
| PublishStatus | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| PublishStateId | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| Tags | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| BlogNewsCode | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| SEOUrl | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |

**Example:**
- `filter=BlogNewsTitle~cn~"spring"`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

---

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| BlogNewsCode | Sort by the blog or news entry code. |
| BlogNewsId | Sort by the blog or news entry identifier. |
| BlogNewsTitle | Sort by the blog or news entry title. |
| BlogNewsType | Sort by the content type. |
| CreatedDate | Sort by the creation date. |
| PublishStateId | Sort by the publish state identifier. |

**Example:**
- `sort=BlogNewsTitle~asc`

---

### Related APIs

- **`POST`** [Create a blog news](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/1w693un10qg0a)
- **`PUT`** [Update a blog news](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2upij7uv4hcvs)
- **`GET`** [Get blog and news](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/oafkznqktyqpt)
- **`PUT`** [Activate/deactivate blog(s)/news. When will activate and deactivate any blognews then the blogNewsId is required](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/j8xso6z6gwab1)
- **`POST`** [Publish a blog news](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/bpifxamwwoggc)

**Filter Format:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| BlogNewsCommentId | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| BlogNewsId | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |

| BlogNewsType | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |

| IsApproved | is (Is) |
| Customer | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| BlogNewsComment | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| LocaleName | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |

**Example:**
- `filter=BlogNewsCommentId~gt~142`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|

Retrieves a list of products belonging to the specified category, including product details and optional facet information. The category code, catalog code, and store code are required to identify the correct catalog and storefront context. Providing the `Znode-ProfileId` header enables profile-specific pricing and catalog visibility in the results.

---

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

| IsActive | Sort by the active status. |
| Name | Sort by the product name. |
| Price | Sort by the product price. |
| SKU | Sort by the product SKU. |

**Example:**
- `sort=Name~asc`

---

### Expand Support

get.summary: Retrieve webstore category details
get.description:
Retrieves published category details for the webstore, including additional attributes such as whether a category has child categories and whether it is hidden from the category menu. Supports nested category retrieval, filtering, sorting, and pagination to help find and display the right categories for the storefront.

**Note:** The ProductIds property present in the response is deprecated and should not be used.

---

### How the API Works

#### 1. Znode-DomainName Header Requirement
To get the categories in the response, you must pass a correct and valid `Znode-DomainName` as a compulsory header. If you do not pass the `Znode-DomainName` in the header, the API returns a 204 No Content response.

**Example:** `Znode-DomainName: hardware-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com`

This will return the categories that are associated to that store.

#### 2. Using Catalog Code Query Parameter
If you want the categories associated to a particular catalog, then pass `catalogCode` as a query parameter. The API validates the store code but does not check the association between the catalog and store code, and `Znode-DomainName`.

#### 3. Behavior with Different Parameter Combinations
- **Without `Znode-DomainName` but with `catalogCode`:** The API will return categories associated to the specified catalog.
- **Without `Znode-DomainName` and without `catalogCode`:** The API will return a 204 No Content response.
- **With both `Znode-DomainName` and `catalogCode`:** The API will return categories associated to the specified catalog.
- **Without `Znode-DomainName`, without `catalogCode`, but with `ZnodeCatalogId` in filter:** The API will return categories associated with that catalogId.

#### 4. Using IsAllCategory Filter for Nested Categories
If you want all the nested or inherited categories in the response, use the `IsAllCategory` filter with value `true`. When set to `true`, the API will return the category along with all its child categories recursively. When set to `false` or not provided, only the root-level categories are returned without their child categories.

#### 5. Using ZnodeCategoryId Filter Requirements
When passing `ZnodeCategoryId` as a filter, you must pass at least one of the following with correct values: `Znode-DomainName` as a header, `catalogCode` as a query parameter, or `ZnodeCatalogId` in the filter. You can pass any combination of these, but all must contain correct values.

#### 6. Using ZnodeCatalogId Filter
When passing `ZnodeCatalogId` in the filter, it is not necessary to pass `catalogCode` and `Znode-DomainName`. However, if passing only `Znode-DomainName`, ensure it contains the URL of the storefront associated with the catalog, and pass the corresponding `catalogCode` for that `ZnodeCatalogId`.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| `ZnodeCatalogId` | `eq` (Equals) |
| `ZnodeCategoryId` | `eq` (Equals) |
| `IsAllCategory` | `eq` (Equals) |

**Example:**
- `filter=ZnodeCatalogId~eq~1`
- `filter=ZnodeCategoryId~eq~10`
- `filter=IsAllCategory~eq~false`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

---

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `DisplayOrder` | Sort by display order. |
| `PublishCategoryId` | Sort by published category ID. |

**Example:**
- `sort=DisplayOrder~asc`
- `sort=PublishCategoryId~desc`

get.summary: List all content containers
get.description:
Retrieves a list of all CMS content containers available in the system. Supports filtering by container key, tags, publish status, and other fields, along with sorting and pagination for efficient browsing of large result sets.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| CMSContentContainerId | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| ContainerKey | cn (Contains), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| Name | cn (Contains), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| Tags | cn (Contains), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| PublishStatus | cn (Contains), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| CreatedByName | cn (Contains), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| CreatedDate | cn (Contains), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| ModifiedByName | cn (Contains), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| ModifiedDate | cn (Contains), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |

**Example:**
- `filter=ContainerKey~cn~homepage`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

---

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| CMSContentContainerId | Sort by the content container identifier. |
| ContainerKey | Sort by the container key. |
| CreatedDate | Sort by the creation date. |
| ModifiedDate | Sort by the last modification date. |
| Name | Sort by the container name. |
| PublishStatus | Sort by the publish status. |

**Example:**
- `sort=ContainerKey~asc`

---

### Related APIs

- **`POST`** [Create a content container](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/qcma6bpc9xaul)
- **`PUT`** [Update a content container](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/xk7pzarhkq0h8)
- **`GET`** [Get content container](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/ujvo17opd8eqn)
- **`DELETE`** [Delete a content container by container key](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/7d6o69zxr3k72)
- **`DELETE`** [Delete content containers (bulk)](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/fberjuythvc82)

For complete filter syntax, supported operators, pagination, and sorting usage, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

For complete filter syntax, supported operators, pagination, and sorting usage, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

get.summary: List all domains
get.description:
Retrieves all domains configured across the platform, including their associated store codes, application types, and active status. Supports filtering, sorting, and pagination for flexible retrieval of domain records.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| ApiKey | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| DomainId | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| DomainName | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| ApplicationType | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| IsDefault | is (Is) |
| IsActive | is (Is) |

**Example:**
- `filter=DomainName~cn~mystore`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

---

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| ApiKey | Sort by the API key. |
| ApplicationType | Sort by the application type. |
| DomainId | Sort by the domain identifier. |
| DomainName | Sort by the domain name. |
| IsActive | Sort by the active status. |
| IsDefault | Sort by the default flag. |

**Example:**
- `sort=DomainName~asc`

---

### Related APIs

- **`GET`** [Retrieve portal detail by store code](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/omest947b67um)
- **`GET`** [Get list of associate countries based on portal](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/fxcvsgnm3vsri)
- **`GET`** [Get the list of profiles associated to portal](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/fnfkl0yr4m2xw)
- **`GET`** [List all states](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/g5ovcbxospadq)
- **`GET`** [List all general settings](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/x2oeo1mpajn0b)

get.summary: List event module display names
get.description:
Retrieves a list of all available event module display names configured in the system. These values represent the functional areas that can trigger events, such as Order, User, Product, Catalog, and Inventory. Use this list to populate module filter options or to validate module names before creating or updating event configurations.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| EventId | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| EventName | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| EventModule | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| IsActive | is (Is) |

**Example:**
- `filter=EventName~eq~"Order"`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

---

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| EventId | Sort by the event identifier. |
| EventName | Sort by the event name. |

**Example:**
- `sort=EventName~asc`

---

### Related APIs

- **`GET`** [Lists all the event details](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/wf3ayb981tsi3)

- **`GET`** [Retrieve event names by module](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/693257sihb0cm)

post.summary: Upload multiple files to the server
post.description:
Uploads one or more media files to the Digital Asset Management (DAM) library. Files must be submitted as multipart/form-data, with each file attached under the `files` field in the request body. Optionally, specify a `folderId` to place uploaded files into a particular folder; if omitted, files are stored in the root folder by default.

---

### Supported file types

Allowed file types are configured by the store administrator. Common supported formats include images (.jpg, .jpeg, .png, .gif, .webp, .svg), documents (.pdf), videos (.mp4), and data or archive files (.zip, .csv, .xlsx). Files with unsupported extensions are rejected. To review or update allowed extensions, go to [DAM / Media Attributes](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000756928-managing-media-attributes#Default-Media-Attributes) in the admin panel.

---

### Unsupported characters in filename

The following characters are not supported in file names and will cause the upload to be rejected: `<`, `>`, `#`, `%`, `|`, `\`, `~`, `'`, `/`, `"`, `,`, `?`

---

### Maximum Supported size

**Single request:** The maximum total size for a single upload request is 20 MB, across all files combined. If the total payload exceeds this limit, the server returns a 413 Payload Too Large response.

**Single file:** The maximum size of an individual file is determined by the Media Attribute configuration. If a file exceeds the configured maximum size (for example, 9 MB when the limit is 8 MB), the upload is rejected and a validation error is returned. You can update the maximum file size limit from [DAM/MediaAttributes](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/MediaManager/Attributes/List).

---

### Bulk upload limits

Multiple files can be included in a single request by attaching each file as a separate `files` entry in the form data or multiple files can be included in a single files entry in the form data. If the total payload exceeds the platform limit, the server returns a 413 Payload Too Large response. To avoid timeouts or partial upload failures, split large uploads into smaller batches. For exact size and count limits, see [Recommendations and Guidelines - Media Explorer](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000779639-recommendations-guidelines-media-explorer).

---

### Related APIs

post.summary: Create a new form widget and email configuration
post.description:
Creates a new form widget configuration along with its associated email configuration for a CMS page or portal. The request must include the WidgetCode and FormBuilderId fields. The first configuration created for a given widget key becomes the default for all locales; if no locale-specific configuration exists, the system returns the default configuration.

**Default Locale Behavior:**
The first form created for a given `WidgetKey` becomes the default configuration for all locales. For example, if a form is created in English (`en`) first, then a request for the same `WidgetKey` using French (`fr`) will return the English configuration, because no French-specific version exists yet.

**Locale-Specific Overrides:**
When you create a form for the same `WidgetKey` in a new locale (e.g., French), the system creates a separate locale-specific configuration. After this entry exists:
1. Requests with `locale = fr` return the French configuration
2. Requests with `locale = en` return the English configuration

If no configuration exists for the requested locale, the system falls back to the default configuration.

**Duplicate Prevention:**
The API does not allow multiple configurations for the same `WidgetKey` and `LocaleId`. Attempts to create a duplicate return the error: *"The form widget configuration with the same details already exists."*

---

put.summary: Update global attribute details
put.description:
Updates the global attribute details for the specified attribute codes. Each entry in the request must include the attribute code, locale code, entity type, entity code, user ID, and store code. For the Form Builder entity type, the portal ID must be greater than 0.

###  Implementation Flow For FILE/IMAGE Attributes Type

When implementing File/Image Type User Defined Fields (UDFs), implementations should always follow this sequential workflow:
1. **Upload File** — Upload the physical file using **[POST /v2/files-upload]**
2. **Receive MediaId** — Retrieve the `MediaId` returned in the response.
3. **Associate MediaId** — Associate the `MediaId` with the target entity.

 **1. File Upload** ([POST /v2/files-upload](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/tbn0amrz39igr-upload-multiple-files-to-the-server))
- Uploads the file directly to Digital Asset Management (DAM).
- Returns a unique `MediaId` upon successful upload.
- Validates the uploaded file strictly against the **DAM → Media Attributes** configuration (allowed file extensions and maximum file size).

 **2. Associating Uploaded Files with Entities** ([PUT /v2/global-entity-attributes](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/6u0i4aqjn95ol-update-global-attribute-details))
- For File/Image type UDFs, the association is established using the `MediaId` returned from **[POST /v2/files-upload]**

**Field Mapping:**
- `AttributeCode` = UDF code
- `AttributeValue` = `MediaId`
- `EntityType` = Entity type
- `EntityCode` = Entity identifier

---

`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|

| `CountryCode` | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |

get.summary: Retrieve product override details by SKU
get.description:
Retrieves product override details for the specified SKU. This endpoint requires the Product Information Override feature to be enabled at both the global and store level. If either flag is disabled, the API returns a 400 Bad Request asking you to verify that the feature is enabled at both levels. When both flags are enabled, the response includes the alternate SKU, alternate product name, alternate short description, and alternate long description for the product.

When override details exist for the given SKU, the overridden values are returned. If no override entry exists for the SKU, the API falls back to the original base product data. Searching by the original product SKU returns the alternate override data if an alternate SKU exists, or the original product data if none does. Searching directly by an alternate SKU returns a 404 Not Found, as alternate SKUs are not independently searchable.

When an account code is supplied in the request header and an override entry exists for the SKU and account code combination, that account-specific data is returned. If an override exists for the SKU but the supplied account code has no matching entry, the store-level override data is returned based on the portal code in the request header. If no override entry exists for the SKU at all, the original base product data is returned regardless of the account code.

This endpoint supports original SKUs only. If an override entry exists for a SKU but the alternate product name, alternate short description, or alternate long description fields are empty, the corresponding values from the parent base product are used instead. If multiple override entries exist for the same combination of store code, locale, account code, and SKU, the response returns one of those entries.

---

get.summary: Retrieve full text search data by keyword
get.description:
Retrieves full text search results for the specified keyword, applying store-level product override configuration when enabled. When the global product override setting is disabled, standard non-override data is always returned. When the global setting is enabled, the store-level override setting determines the final behavior: if the store-level setting is on, override-aware search content is returned; if it is off, standard non-override data is returned.

If an account code is provided in the request header, results are returned in the context of that account. Pagination applies only to product results and is not supported for facets, which are always returned in full without pagination.

This endpoint supports 'Did You Mean' suggestions. Suggestions are generated only when the Did You Mean feature is enabled in the Search Index Settings in the admin panel. To enable this feature, navigate to [Search Index Settings](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/SearchConfiguration/GetTabStructureSearchIndex), go to PimIndex Settings, click Edit on the desired search index setting, and enable the Did You Mean option. Once enabled, search responses will include keyword correction suggestions.

Facet details will be returned when either IsFacetList is set to true or Facet is included in the Expand parameter; either condition is sufficient to fetch the facet details.

---

get.summary: Retrieve product override details for multiple SKUs
get.description:
Retrieves product override details for one or more SKUs in a single request. Provide up to 32 SKUs as a comma-separated list in the path parameter; requests that exceed this limit return a validation error. Both the global Product Information Override flag and the store-level Product Information Override flag must be enabled for override data to be returned — if either flag is off, the request returns a 400 error with instructions to verify the settings.

When a request is made with an original product SKU, the API checks whether an override entry exists for that SKU. If override details are found, the response includes the overridden values such as the alternate SKU, alternate product name, alternate short description, and alternate long description. If no override entry exists for the SKU, the API returns the original product data. Searching directly with an alternate (override) SKU returns a 404 Not Found response, as alternate SKUs are not independently searchable.

If an account code is provided in the request header and an override entry exists for the combination of that SKU and account code, the account-specific override data is returned. If an override entry exists for the SKU but no match is found for the provided account code, the store-level override data associated with the portal is returned. If no override entry exists at all for the SKU — with or without an account code — the original product data is returned.

get.summary: Retrieve keyword search suggestions for product overrides
get.description:
Retrieves keyword search suggestions for product overrides based on the supplied search keyword, catalog code, and store context. The response respects both global and store-level product override settings, and falls back to standard product data when overrides are not applicable.

Product override behavior depends on two flags. If the global product override flag is disabled, overrides are not applied and standard data is always returned. If the global flag is enabled but the store-level override flag is disabled, overrides are still not applied and standard data is returned. Only when both the global and store-level override flags are enabled will the endpoint apply product override logic and return overridden data.

When override logic is active, the endpoint checks whether override details exist for the given keyword. If an override entry is found, the overridden values are returned. If no override entry exists for the keyword, the response falls back to data from the original product catalog. When an Account Code is supplied in the request header and an override entry exists for the combination of SKU and Account Code, that account-specific data is returned. If an override exists for the SKU but does not match the supplied Account Code, the SKU-level override data for the store is returned instead. If no override entry exists for the SKU at all, the base product SKU data is returned.

---

- **`GET`** [PIM Override – Full Text Search Data](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/twwsfigh0zlj5)

get.summary: Retrieve promotion details by entity type and code
get.description:
Retrieves a list of promotions associated with a specified entity type and entity code. The entity type identifies the category of entity (such as brand, catalog, category, or product), and the entity code identifies the specific entity instance. Supports filtering, sorting, and pagination for flexible retrieval of results.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| PromotionId | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| Name | cn (Contains), nlk (NotLike) |
| PromoCode | eq (Equals), nlk (NotLike) |
| PromotionTypeName | cn (Contains), nlk (NotLike) |
| Discount | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| StartDate | nlk (NotLike) |
| EndDate | nlk (NotLike) |
| IsCouponRequired | is (Is) |
| StoreName | nlk (NotLike) |

**Example:**
- `filter=PromotionId~gt~142`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

---

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| promocode | Sort by the promotion code. |

**Example:**
- `sort=promocode~asc`

---

### Expand Support

Specifies which additional related resources to include in the response. Multiple values can be specified by repeating the parameter (e.g. `expand=Value1&expand=Value2`).

**Supported Expand Values:**

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| additionalattributes | Includes additional custom attributes for each promotion in the response. |

**Allowed values:** `additionalattributes`

**Example:**
- `["additionalattributes"]`

---

post.summary: Deactivate promotion coupons.
post.description:
Deactivates one or more coupon codes associated with the promotion identified by route parameter `code`, preventing those coupons from being redeemed in future transactions. This endpoint supports bulk deactivation by accepting multiple comma-separated coupon codes in a single request.

The response returns an individual processing result for each coupon code and indicates whether each coupon was successfully deactivated or could not be processed.

---

### Deactivation behavior

- Multiple coupon codes can be submitted in one request using a comma-separated `CouponCode` value.
- Coupon deactivation is evaluated per coupon code and reported in the `DeactivatePromotionCouponResults` collection.
- Each result item includes the coupon code, HTTP-style status code, activation state after processing, and operation message.
- Per-item statuses can include `200` (success), `400` (already inactive or already used), `404` (coupon not found), and `409` (coupon does not belong to the supplied promotion).

---

### Validation and processing rules

- `code` (path parameter) and `CouponCode` are required.
- If the request contains invalid input, the request is rejected with a validation error and no coupons are deactivated.
- If the supplied promotion code does not exist, the request returns not found and no coupons are deactivated.

---

### Related APIs

- **`POST`** [Activate promotion coupons](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/ph3m9k2s7r4q).
- **`POST`** [Generate promotion coupons](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/4rzyq0x2apm7n).

200.description:
**Success (200 OK)**

- The request was successfully processed.
- Coupon deactivation was executed for the specified promotion.
- The response includes a `DeactivatePromotionCouponResults` collection containing the outcome for each requested coupon code.
- Each result indicates whether the coupon was successfully processed or provides the reason it could not be processed.

post.summary: Activate promotion coupons.
post.description:
Activates one or more coupon codes associated with the promotion identified by route parameter `code`, allowing those coupons to be used in future transactions. This endpoint supports bulk activation by accepting multiple comma-separated coupon codes in a single request.

The response returns an individual processing result for each coupon code and indicates whether each coupon was successfully activated or could not be processed.

---

### Activation behavior

- Multiple coupon codes can be submitted in one request using a comma-separated `CouponCode` value.
- Coupon activation is evaluated per coupon code and reported in the `ActivatePromotionCouponResults` collection.
- Each result item includes the coupon code, HTTP-style status code, activation state after processing, and operation message.
- Per-item statuses can include `200` (success), `400` (already active or already used), `404` (coupon not found), and `409` (coupon does not belong to the supplied promotion).

---

### Validation and processing rules

- `code` (path parameter) and `CouponCode` are required.
- If the request contains invalid input, the request is rejected with a validation error and no coupons are activated.
- If the supplied promotion code does not exist, the request returns not found and no coupons are activated.

---

### Related APIs

- **`POST`** [Deactivate promotion coupons](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/9jwh8trb2w6kq).
- **`POST`** [Generate promotion coupons](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/4rzyq0x2apm7n).

post.summary: Generate promotion coupons.
post.description:
Generates one or more unique coupon codes for an existing promotion identified by the provided promotion code. Coupon generation is based on the requested coupon code format, coupon code length, and quantity.

Custom coupon generation is supported through a user-defined value that can be added to each generated coupon as a prefix or suffix, based on the selected custom coupon type.

---

### Coupon Generation Behavior

- Coupon codes are generated uniquely for the specified promotion.
- Coupon generation is supported only for promotions where the unique coupon flag is enabled.
- The selected `CouponCodeFormat` and `CouponCodeLength` are applied to all generated coupon codes in the request.
- `CustomCouponType` and `CustomCouponCode` are both optional.
- If either `CustomCouponType` or `CustomCouponCode` is provided, both fields must be provided.

---

### Limit and Validation Rules

- A maximum of 99,999 coupons can be generated in a single request.
- If the requested quantity exceeds 99,999, the request is rejected with a validation error and no coupons are generated.
- If the request contains invalid input, the request is rejected and no coupons are generated.
- If the target promotion does not have unique coupon enabled, coupon generation is rejected.

---

### Related APIs

- **`GET`** [Retrieve promotion details by entity type and code](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/9j46yq8x2cz3b).
- **`POST`** [Deactivate promotion coupons](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/9jwh8trb2w6kq).

post.summary: Submit a back-in-stock notification request
post.description:
Creates a new back-in-stock notification request that registers a customer's email address to receive an alert when the specified product variant becomes available again. All six fields are required: parent product SKU, product variant SKU, customer email address, desired quantity, store code, and catalog code.

**SKU Validation:**
Both `ProductSKU` and `ParentSKU` are validated against the published product catalog. If either SKU does not exist or the relationship between them is invalid, the API returns a 400 Bad Request response.

**Quantity Validation:**
The `Quantity` field must be between 1 and 2,000,000,000 units. If the quantity is outside this range, the API returns a 400 Bad Request response.

**Store and Catalog Resolution:**
`StoreCode` and `CatalogCode` are required to resolve the store and catalog internally. If the storeCode or catalogCode is invalid, the API returns a 400 Bad Request response.

**Duplicate Behavior:**
The API does not prevent duplicate stock notification requests for the same email address and product SKU combination. Each call creates a new notification entry.

**Stock Notification Submission Conditions:**
A stock notification request will be accepted and submitted only if the following conditions are met:
- The product's out-of-stock behavior is set to `DisablePurchasing`.
- The product inventory is zero across all associated warehouses.
- The product is not marked as obsolete.
- The product status is active.

If any of these conditions are not met, the API returns a 400 Bad Request response.

---

### Related APIs

- **`GET`** [Get published product](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/n2xoaj5b2ihu5)
- **`GET`** [Published Product Inventory List](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/k6a2rybcs7ub3)
- **`POST`** [Validate products by SKU list](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/xyhfnb625q950)
- **`GET`** [Get product pricing details by SKU, portal code and locale code](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/d2c2fmhmwafiy)
- **`GET`** [Get users wish list](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/sp4acre33orox)

requestBody.description: The stock notification details for registering a customer's interest in being notified when a product is back in stock.

Example 1.summary: Notify when SKU-BLUE-SM is back in stock

201.description: **Created** - The stock notification request was successfully created. The response echoes the submitted request details.

204.description: **No Content** - The request was successfully processed, but no content is returned in the response body.

400.description:
**Bad Request** - The request contains invalid data. Common causes include:
- Missing required field: `ParentSKU`, `ProductSKU`, `Email`, `Quantity`, `StoreCode`, or `CatalogCode`.
- `Email` format is invalid (must be a valid email address like user@domain.com).
- `Quantity` is less than 1 or greater than 2,000,000,000.
- `ProductSKU` or `ParentSKU` does not exist in the published product catalog.
- Invalid relationship between `ProductSKU` and `ParentSKU`.
- `StoreCode` or `CatalogCode` is invalid or does not exist.
- Product's out-of-stock behavior is not set to `DisablePurchasing`.
- Product inventory is not zero across all associated warehouses.
- Product is marked as obsolete or status is not active.

get.summary: List all URL redirects
get.description:
Retrieves a list of URL redirect rules configured in the system. Supports filtering, sorting, and pagination for flexible retrieval of results.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| CMSUrlRedirectId | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| PortalId | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| IsActive | is (Is) |
| RedirectFrom | cn (Contains), ew (EndsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike), sw (StartsWith) |
| RedirectTo | cn (Contains), ew (EndsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike), sw (StartsWith) |
| CreatedBy | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| CreatedDate | eq (Equals), nlk (NotLike) |
| ModifiedBy | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| ModifiedDate | eq (Equals), nlk (NotLike) |

**Example:**
- `filter=RedirectFrom~cn~"/old-page"`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

---

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| CMSUrlRedirectId | Sort by the URL redirect identifier. |
| CreatedDate | Sort by the creation date. |
| IsActive | Sort by the active status. |
| PortalId | Sort by the store identifier. |
| RedirectFrom | Sort by the source redirect URL. |

**Example:**
- `sort=CMSUrlRedirectId~asc`

---

### Related APIs

- **`GET`** [Retrieves SEO details based on the provided parameters](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/901zzzy0lyaxq)
- **`GET`** [Get SEO Url Details by Seo Url and storeCode](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/ymw7vllxc806d)

- **`GET`** [Retrieve portal detail by store code](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/omest947b67um)

get.summary: Retrieve full text search data
get.description:
**Note:** This API replaces the deprecated [Retrieve full text search catalog data](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/yz0kh46ti9wtg) (`GET /v2/search/full-text-search`). Use this API for all new implementations.

Retrieves a paginated list of products and facets matching the provided full text search keyword. Supports expansion of related data such as pricing, SEO details, and promotions, as well as pagination for navigating large result sets.

**Conditional Behavior Based on Catalog Configuration:**

When the catalog flag 'Display Pricing and SEO Details of Products from Index' [learn more](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000761619-editing-a-catalog-name-and-index-settings#Index-Settings) is **disabled**:
- The `StoreCode` parameter becomes required (instead of optional).
- SEO and pricing details are not returned by default — you must explicitly include `seo` and/or `price` in the `expand` parameter to retrieve them.

When the catalog flag is **enabled**:
- The `StoreCode` and `expand` parameters are optional.
- SEO and pricing details are automatically indexed and returned without the `expand` parameter.

**Did You Mean (DYM) Functionality:**

This endpoint supports 'Did You Mean' suggestions. Suggestions are only generated if the Did You Mean feature has been enabled by the admin in the Search Index Settings. If disabled, no suggestions will be returned.

**How to Enable DYM:**
1. Navigate to [Search Index Settings](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/SearchConfiguration/GetTabStructureSearchIndex).
2. Go to PimIndex Settings.
3. Click **Edit** on the desired search index setting.
4. Enable the **Did You Mean (DYM)** option.
5. Once enabled, keyword suggestions will include DYM corrections.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| IsGetAllLocationsInventory| cn (Contains), eq (Equals) |

**Example:**
- `filter=IsGetAllLocationsInventory~eq~true`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

---

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| Price | Sort by the product price. |

**Example:**
- `sort=Price~asc`

---

### Expand Support

Specifies which additional related resources to include in the response. Multiple values can be specified by repeating the parameter (e.g. `expand=Value1&expand=Value2`).

**Supported Expand Values:**

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| Pricing | Includes pricing details such as retail price, sales price, and currency for each product. |
| Seo | Includes SEO metadata such as title, description, keywords, and URL for each product. |

**Allowed values:**  `Pricing`, `Seo`

**Example:**
- `["Pricing", "Seo"]`

---

### Related APIs

- **`GET`** [Get full text search data](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/8ckxfxsk2676k)
- **`GET`** [Get full text search catalog data](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/yz0kh46ti9wtg)
- **`GET`** [PIM Override — Full Text Search Data](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/8ckxfxsk2676k)
- **`GET`** [Retrieve search term results for hydrated typeahead](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/17et2qt31zcnl)
- **`GET`** [Retrieves keyword search suggestions based on the provided search criteria.](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/7fju96ixnifnx)

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

**Example:**
- `sort=ZnodeCatalogId~asc`

---

### Expand Support

get.summary: Retrieve SEO URL details by SEO URL and store code
get.description:
Retrieves SEO URL details for the specified SEO-friendly URL path within the context of the given store. The response includes the associated resource information such as the category, product, CMS page, or other mapped content linked to the URL. Optional locale and catalog codes can be provided to return localized or catalog-specific results.

If the catalog code and store code provided are currently associated, the response includes SEO URL details along with related product information. If the catalog code was previously associated with the store but the store is now mapped to a different catalog, the response may still include SEO URL details from previously published data, though product details may not be returned for the old catalog mapping. get.summary: Get the list of content blocks.
get.description:
Retrieves a paginated list of all content blocks. Supports filtering, sorting, and pagination for flexible retrieval of results.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| CMSContentBlockCode | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| CMSContentBlockName | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| Tags | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| LocaleId | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals), eq (Equals) |
| IsActive | is (Is) |
| PublishStatus | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |

**Example:**
- `filter=CMSContentBlockName~cn~"banner"`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-core-api-v2---internal/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

---

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| CMSContentBlockCode | Sort by the content block code. |
| CMSContentBlockName | Sort by the content block name. |
| IsActive | Sort by the active status. |
| PublishStateId | Sort by the publish state identifier. |

**Example:**
- `sort=CMSContentBlockName~asc`

---

get.summary: List all search feature setting stores
get.description:
Retrieves a list of all search feature setting stores configured across the platform. Each result includes the store's search configuration, feature codes, and associated settings. Supports filtering, sorting, and pagination for flexible retrieval of results.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| PortalId | gt (GreaterThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| StoreName | cn (Contains), ew (EndsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike), sw (StartsWith) |
| StoreCode | nlk (NotLike) |
| FeatureCode | nlk (NotLike) |
| CompanyName | nlk (NotLike) |
| IsEnabled | is (Is) |
| IsActive | is (Is) |
| IsSystemDefined | is (Is) |
| IsApproved | is (Is) |
| IsAutoApproved | is (Is) |
| CreatedBy | gt (GreaterThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| ModifiedBy | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| CreatedDate | nlk (NotLike) |
| ModifiedDate | nlk (NotLike) |

**Example:**
- `filter=StoreName~cn~"Znode Store"`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

---

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| CreatedDate | Sort by the creation date. |
| ModifiedDate | Sort by the last modification date. |
| PortalId | Sort by the store (portal) identifier. |

**Example:**
- `sort=CreatedDate~asc`

---

### Expand Support

Specifies which additional related resources to include in the response. Multiple values can be specified by repeating the parameter (e.g. `expand=Value1&expand=Value2`).

**Supported Expand Values:**

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| SearchSettings | Includes the search feature settings details for each store. |
| Store | Includes additional store information and configuration. |

**Allowed values:** `SearchSettings`, `Store`

**Example:**
- `["SearchSettings", "Store"]`

---

### Related APIs

- **`GET`** [Get store feature settings](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/r931fiwiw4vk4)
- **`POST`** [Create search feature setting for given store details](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/ap9lgpjjlhjrt)
- **`PUT`** [Update search feature setting for given store details](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/l3ga09nq4wwa8)
- **`DELETE`** [Delete search feature setting for given store](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/0mssg78syrkut)
- **`GET`** [List all general settings](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/x2oeo1mpajn0b)

post.summary: Create SEO details for a product, category, or content page.
post.description:
Creates SEO details for a content entity (product, category, or content page) within the specified portal and locale context.

This endpoint accepts an SEOModel payload and validates required identifiers (**SEOCode, CMSSEOTypeId, PortalId, LocaleId, and ItemName**), SEO content fields, SEO code format, robot tag value, duplicate SEO URL, and duplicate SEO code/type/portal combinations before persisting data. For content-page requests, **CMSContentPagesId** is required. 

If a content-page SEO base record already exists in ZnodeCMSSEODetail, the endpoint updates that existing record during create (upsert behavior) instead of inserting a duplicate. For other SEO types, standard create behavior applies with duplicate checks.

On success, the API creates or updates a draft SEO detail record, stores locale-specific SEO metadata (title, description, keywords, canonical URL, and robot tag), and returns the resulting SEO detail in the response body.


---

put.summary: Update SEO details for a product, category, or content page.
put.description:
Updates existing SEO details for a content entity (product, category, or content page) within the specified portal and locale context.

This endpoint accepts an **SEOModel** payload and updates an existing SEO record by validating the target identifier (**CMSSEODetailId**) and matching the request context (**PortalId, SEOCode, CMSSEOTypeId, and ItemName**) against the existing stored record before applying changes.

During the update, the API validates SEO field input (including SEO code format, robot tag value, and duplicate SEO URL checks), updates draft SEO data, persists locale-specific SEO metadata (title, description, keywords, canonical URL, and robot tag), and applies redirect handling when enabled and the SEO URL changes. 

For content-page requests, **CMSContentPagesId** is a required parameter.

For optional SEO fields (such as SEO title, description, keywords, canonical URL, and robot tag), if a property is omitted from the request payload, the existing stored value is retained. To explicitly clear an existing value, pass an empty string ("") for that property.

---

get.summary: List all states
get.description:
Retrieves a list of states with support for filtering, sorting, and pagination. Use the `filter` parameter to narrow results by country code, state code, state name, or state ID.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| CountryCode | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| StateCode | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| StateName | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| StateId | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |

**Example:**
- `filter=CountryCode~cn~US`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

---

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| CountryCode | Sort by the country code. |
| StateCode | Sort by the state code. |
| StateName | Sort by the state name. |
| StateId | Sort by the state identifier. |

**Example:**
- `sort=StateName~asc`

---

### Related APIs

- **`GET`** [Get list of associate countries based on portal](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/fxcvsgnm3vsri)
- **`GET`** [List all addresses across the customers](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/8ctn34qcrm61b)

- **`GET`** [List of user addresses](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/9dhf5quwu2xrh)
- **`GET`** [List all store locators with filtering and sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/3dygzvau69u95)

put.summary: Update a customer account by username
put.description:
Updates the customer account identified by the specified username. The request body must include the email address, the ASP.NET user ID, and the store code. Optional profile details such as first name, last name, phone number, email opt-in, and SMS opt-in preferences may also be provided to update the user's profile.

Role assignment behavior depends on the combination of account ID and role name included in the request. When an account ID is supplied, the user is treated as a B2B user and must be assigned a B2B role such as User, Manager, or Administrator; providing a non-B2B role alongside an account ID is not permitted. When no account ID is provided and no role name is given, the system assigns the default Customer role. When no account ID is provided but a role name is specified, the system assigns that role and replaces any existing non-portal role. Commerce Portal roles are always added alongside existing roles rather than replacing them, regardless of the user type. If the user already holds an Admin role, passing an account ID is not permitted and returns an error stating that an account cannot be associated with an Admin user. Converting an Admin user to a Customer role is also not allowed. The account provided must be associated with the specified store; if it is not, the request returns an error stating that the account is not associated with the provided store.

---

post.summary: Change a user's account password
post.description:
Updates the account password for a registered user based on the provided store code and user credentials. The request accepts either the current password for a standard change, or a one-time password reset token for a token-based password reset. Returns the username and a success indicator upon completion.

---

### IDOR Validation and User-Based Data Access Behavior

This endpoint enforces ownership validation when the EnableJwtOwnershipValidation feature is enabled. This feature is turned off by default and can only be enabled by updating the tenant-specific configuration directly; it is not available as a setting in the Admin panel. When enabled, the system ensures that the authenticated user can only change their own password. Any attempt to change the password of a different user account is rejected with a 403 Forbidden response.

---

### Related APIs

- **`POST`** [Send forgot password email to user](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2lvyutd96b9gf)

- **`POST`** [Bulk reset password](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/599vh3wnf37xb)

- **`POST`** [Authenticate user and return login session details](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/uqiqwp77aw2a7)

200.description: **Success** - The request was successfully executed. The response contains the result of the password change, including whether the operation succeeded and the affected username.

204.description: **No Content** - The request was processed but the password change could not be applied. This may indicate the user was not found or the operation produced no result.

400.description: **Bad Request** - The request contains invalid data. Common causes include missing required fields, invalid parameter values, or malformed request body content.

403.description: **Forbidden** - The authenticated user does not have permission to change this password. This may occur when the EnableJwtOwnershipValidation feature is enabled and the authenticated user attempts to change the password of a different user account.

post.summary: Validate user credentials
post.description:
Validates the credentials of a registered user and returns core identity details upon successful verification, including UserId, RoleName, and StoreCode. This endpoint is for credential verification only and does not generate or return an authentication token. The store context is required and must be provided either in the request body as StoreCode or via the Znode-DomainName request header. When both are present, the StoreCode in the request body takes precedence.

If the Znode-DomainName header is provided, the system maps it to the associated store code and validates that the domain is in an Active state. If the domain corresponds to an application type other than Webstore or Webstore Preview, the StoreCode in the response is set to *.

If a user is associated with multiple roles, the effective role is determined by the first matching role assignment found for that user.

This endpoint does not require an authentication token, as it is configured to skip the standard authentication check. For security reasons, authentication failures return a generic error message with an HTTP 401 status to prevent attempts to infer valid credentials based on specific error responses.

---

### Related APIs

Validates the login token by processing it through the cache to confirm authenticity. If the token is valid, the response contains the user's login details. If no matching token is found, the operation returns an empty response with no content.

---

### Related APIs

- **`POST`** [Handles generation of login token](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/4ug2eis4zbg9g)
- **`POST`** [Validates the given CSR token](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/58p6rf1pksclh)
- **`POST`** [Validate Impersonation Token](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/hpuxc3782tqj1)
- **`GET`** [Validate authentication token](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/1az1f2ig6438i)
- **`POST`** [Validate user credentials](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/vpe0pf89c66li)

200.description: **Success** - The login token was successfully validated. The response contains the user's login details.

204.description: **No Content** - The request was successfully processed, but no matching token was found for the specified criteria.

400.description:
**Bad Request** - The request contains invalid data. Common causes include:
- Missing required field `Token`.
- Invalid or unrecognised value for `Token`.

404.description: **Not Found** - The specified login token was not found. Verify that the token value is correct and that the token exists.

500.description: **Internal Server Error** - An unexpected error occurred on the server while processing the request. Please try again later or contact support if the issue persists.

post.summary: Verify reset password link status
post.description:

200.description: **Success** - The request was successfully executed. The response indicates whether the password reset link is still active and valid for the specified user.

204.description: **No Content** - The request was successfully processed, but no data was returned for the specified reset password link.

get.summary: Retrieve content page preview details for the visual editor
get.description:
**Note:** This API replaces the deprecated [Retrieve visual editor content page preview details](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/kaci98ss0z4w0) (`GET /v2/visual-editor/content-pages-preview/{pageCode}/{portalCode}/{profileCode}`). Use this API for all new implementations.

Retrieves the content page details for the specified page code, portal code, and profile code, as used by the CMS visual editor for preview and editing. An optional version number can be specified to load a specific historical version of the page; if omitted, the latest published version is returned.

---

### Related APIs

- **`GET`** [Retrieve visual editor content page details](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/c4ohm3ldj9s07)
- **`GET`** [Retrieve visual editor preview page details](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/b2svftdbq4r4b)
- **`GET`** [Retrieve the commerce page preview details for the visual editor.](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/79a002e47d021)

parameters.name: versionNumber
parameters.description:
The version number of the content page to retrieve. Use `0` to get the latest published version. Specify a version number to preview a specific historical state of the page.

**Default:** 0 (latest version)

parameters.name: pageCode
parameters.description:
The unique code identifying the content page to retrieve. This code is assigned when the page is created in the CMS and is used to locate the specific page within the visual editor.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Content Pages](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Content/ContentPageList)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Go to CMS, then select Pages.
2. Click Edit on the desired page.
3. Note the Page Code value shown in the page detail form.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Content Pages](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757018-managing-content-pages)

parameters.name: portalCode
parameters.description:
**The unique portal (store) code** associated with the content page. Identifies which store's context to use when rendering the page preview.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Store List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Go to Stores → Stores.
2. Click Edit on the desired store.
3. Locate the Store Code field.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Stores](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757163-managing-stores)

parameters.name: profileCode
parameters.description:
The unique code identifying the user profile associated with the content page. Profiles control which content variations and layouts are displayed for different customer segments.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [User Profiles](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Profiles/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to Accounts and Users, then select User Profiles.
2. Note the Profile Code value shown in the profile list.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing User Profiles](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757042-managing-user-profiles)

200.description: **Success** - The request was successfully executed. The response contains the content page preview details for the specified page code, portal code, and profile code, including the page JSON structure and metadata.

204.description: **No Content** - The request was successfully processed, but no content page data was found for the specified page code, portal code, and profile code combination.

400.description:
**Bad Request** - The request contains invalid data. Common causes include:
- Missing required path parameter `pageCode`, `portalCode`, or `profileCode`.
- Invalid version number format.

value.ErrorMessage: PageCode is required.

404.description: **Not Found** - The specified content page, portal, or profile was not found. Verify that the `pageCode`, `portalCode`, and `profileCode` values are correct and the resources exist.

value.ErrorMessage: The requested content page could not be found.

500.description: **Internal Server Error** - An unexpected error occurred on the server while processing the request. Please try again later or contact support if the issue persists.

value.ErrorMessage: An unexpected error occurred on the server while processing the request. Please try again later or contact support.

get.summary: Retrieve the commerce page preview details for the visual editor
get.description:

Retrieves the commerce (non-content) page preview details upon initialization of the visual editor, based on a combination of Page Code, Portal Code, Profile Code, and Version Number. Unlike content page previews, this endpoint handles commerce-specific pages such as product listing pages, cart pages, and checkout pages.

---

### Related APIs

- **`GET`** [Retrieve visual editor content page preview details](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/b2svftdbq4r4b)

parameters.name: versionNumber
parameters.description: The version number of the commerce page to retrieve. Use `0` to get the latest published version. Specific version numbers allow previewing historical page states.

parameters.name: pageCode
parameters.description:
The unique code identifying the commerce page to preview in the visual editor.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Content / Content Page List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Content/ContentPageList)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [Content / Content Page List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Content/ContentPageList).
2. Click Edit on the desired page.
3. Note the Page Code value shown in the Edit Page form.

parameters.name: portalCode
parameters.description:
The unique portal (store) code associated with the commerce page. Identifies which store's context to use when rendering the page preview.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Store List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Go to Stores, then select Manage Stores.
2. Click Edit on the desired store.
3. Note the Store Code value displayed in the store details form.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Stores](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757163-managing-stores)

parameters.name: profileCode
