The unique code identifying the customer profile to use when rendering the commerce page preview. Profiles control page layouts and pricing tiers for different customer segments.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Accounts & Users / User Profiles](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Profiles/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to Accounts and Users, then select User Profiles.
2. Locate the desired profile in the list.
3. Note the Profile Code value shown in the profile list.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing User Profiles](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757042-managing-user-profiles)

200.description: **Success** - The request was successfully executed. The response contains the commerce page preview details, including page layout and metadata for the specified page code, portal code, and profile code combination.

204.description: **No Content** - The request was successfully processed, but no commerce page data was found for the specified page code, portal code, and profile code combination.

400.description: **Bad Request** - The request contains invalid data. Common causes include missing required path parameters or invalid parameter formats.

404.description: **Not Found** - The specified commerce page, portal, or profile could not be found. Verify that the page code, portal code, and profile code are correct.

500.description: **Internal Server Error** - An unexpected error occurred on the server while processing the request. Please try again later or contact support if the issue persists.

post.description:

The request requires the page code, portal code, one or more profile codes, and the full page layout as a JSON string. Once published, the page becomes immediately live on the storefront for all targeted profiles.

get.summary: List all gift card vouchers
get.description:
Retrieves a list of gift card vouchers associated with the portal of the authenticated user. The portal is determined automatically from the Znode-UserId header, ensuring results are scoped to the correct store. Supports filtering by card fields such as card number, amount, and status, along with sorting and pagination for efficient retrieval of large voucher datasets.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| GiftCardId | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| CardNumber | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| Name | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| Amount | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| RemainingAmount | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| IsActive | is (Is) |
| PortalId | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| UserId | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| CustomerName | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| AccountName | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| AccountCode | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| StoreName | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| CreatedDate | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| ModifiedDate | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| StartDate | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| ExpirationDate | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| CultureCode | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| CurrencyCode | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |

**Example:**
- `filter=IsActive~is~true`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

---

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| GiftCardId | Sort by the gift card identifier. |
| CardNumber | Sort by the card number. |
| Name | Sort by the gift card name. |
| UserId | Sort by the user identifier. |

**Example:**
- `sort=CardNumber~asc`

---

post.summary: Validate products by SKU list
post.description:
Validates one or more product SKUs against the specified catalog and store. The request body accepts a comma-separated list of SKU codes, and only SKUs that exist and are published in the specified catalog are included in the response. The SKU sequence provided in the request is preserved and returned in the same order in the response.

For bundle products, the available quantity (QuantityOnHand) is determined by the inventory configuration of its child items. If any child item is configured with "Disable Purchasing When Out of Stock", bundle availability is restricted by the most constrained child item, ensuring purchases cannot exceed the limiting component. If all child items are configured with "Allow Back Ordering" or "Do Not Track Inventory", bundle availability is determined by the maximum possible bundle quantity based on child item availability. The inventory code is set according to the bundle's out-of-stock options configuration, and minimum and maximum quantity values are derived from the parent bundle configuration.

If at least one child item is configured with "Disable Purchasing When Out of Stock", this configuration takes precedence and the bundle quantity is restricted based on those items. If multiple such items exist, the bundle quantity is determined using the most constrained item among them. Child items configured with "Allow Back Ordering" or "Do Not Track Inventory" do not limit bundle quantity when a "Disable Purchasing When Out of Stock" item exists.

The constraint is calculated using the ratio of available quantity to required quantity for each child item. For example:

| Child Item | Available Quantity | Required Quantity | Calculated Value |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 96 | 12 | 96 / 12 = 8 |
| 2 | 100 | 5 | 100 / 5 = 20 |

If any child item is configured with "Disable Purchasing When Out of Stock", the QuantityOnHand is 8. If all child items are configured with "Allow Back Ordering" or "Do Not Track Inventory", the QuantityOnHand is 20.

---

get.summary: Retrieves the list of blogs or news with optional date range filters
get.description:
**Note:** This API replaces the deprecated [Retrieve blog and news list for a webstore](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/0zd8oyz9e3id5) (`GET /v2/webstore-blog-news`). Use this API for all new implementations.

Retrieves a paginated list of blog or news items for the specified store and locale. Results support localization, pagination, and filtering based on optional activation and expiration date ranges.

---

### Notes

- This v2.1 endpoint replaces the *ActivationDate* query parameter available in **v2/webstore-blog-news** with date range filters. Use the *filter* parameter to specify one or more of the following filters:

  1. ActivationDateFrom
  2. ActivationDateTo
  3. ExpirationDateFrom
  4. ExpirationDateTo

- Date filtering is supported only through the above date range filters.
- If both *From* and *To* date filters are specified, the *From* date must be less than or equal to the corresponding *To* date.
- Records with a `null` ActivationDate or `null` ExpirationDate are always included in the results, regardless of the date range filters applied, as `null` values are treated as active.
- Parameters `storeCode` and `blogNewsType` are required.
- If `localeCode` is not provided, the store's default locale is used.

---

### Filter Support

get.summary: Retrieve banner slider data for a specific widget
get.description:
**Note:** This API replaces the deprecated [Retrieve slider data for a webstore widget](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/u7ezk9u9tw642) (`GET /v2/webstore-widgets/{widgetKey}/sliders`). Use this API for all new implementations.

Retrieves all configured banner slider details from the CMS for a specific widget, identified by the `widgetKey` path parameter. The request requires `CMSMappingId`, `TypeOfMapping`, and `StoreCode` as query parameters to resolve the correct slider configuration.

The set of banners returned is determined by the request headers `Znode-UserId`, `Znode-AccountId` and `Znode-DomainName`, which control user-context-aware content visibility:

**Case 1: Guest User (UserId = 0)**

When `UserId` is `0`, the request is treated as a guest session. The API returns:
- Banners available to **all users** (shown to everyone, including guests)
- Banners linked to the store's **default anonymous profile**
- Banners available to **all profiles** (shown to users of any profile)

Account-specific banners are excluded.

**Case 2: Logged-in User with Account (UserId ≠ 0 and AccountId ≠ 0)**

When both `UserId` and `AccountId` are provided, the request is treated as a logged-in user. The API returns:
- Banners available to **all users** (shown to everyone)
- Banners available to **all accounts** (shown to users of any account)
- Banners targeted to the **specific account** (matching the provided `AccountId`)
- Banners available to **all profiles** (shown to users of any profile)
- Banners associated with the user's **default profile**

**Case 3: Logged-in User without Account (UserId ≠ 0 and AccountId = 0)**

When `UserId` is provided but `AccountId` is `0`, the API returns:
- Banners available to **all users** (shown to everyone)
- Banners available to **all profiles** (shown to users of any profile)
- Banners associated with the user's **default profile**

Account-specific banners are excluded.

---

### Related APIs

- **`GET`** [List of cms widgets](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/hv0fxn7gdefpy)

get.summary: Retrieve wish list for a user by username
get.description:
Retrieves the wish list for the specified user, including the saved products and their associated details. The response includes product information such as promotions, inventory, pricing, add-ons, and reviews depending on the expand values supplied. This endpoint enforces ownership validation when enabled, ensuring that users can only retrieve their own wish list. Any attempt to access another user's wish list results in a 403 Forbidden response.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| UserWishListId | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| UserId | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |
| SKU | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| WishListAddedDate | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| CreatedBy | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| CreatedDate | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| ModifiedBy | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| ModifiedDate | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| AddOnSKUs | cn (Contains), eq (Equals), ew (EndsWith), sw (StartsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains), nlk (NotLike) |
| PortalId | gt (GreaterThan), lt (LessThan), in (In), le (LessThanOrEqual), ne (NotEquals) |

**Example:**
- `filter=SKU~cn~PROD-001`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

---

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| UserWishListId | Sort by the wish list item identifier. |
| UserId | Sort by the user identifier. |
| SKU | Sort by the product SKU. |
| WishListAddedDate | Sort by the date the item was added to the wish list. |
| CreatedBy | Sort by the user who created the record. |
| CreatedDate | Sort by the creation date. |
| ModifiedBy | Sort by the user who last modified the record. |
| ModifiedDate | Sort by the last modification date. |
| PortalId | Sort by the store identifier. |

**Example:**
- `sort=WishListAddedDate~desc`

---

### Expand Support

Specifies which additional related resources to include in the response. Multiple values can be specified by repeating the parameter (e.g. `expand=Value1&expand=Value2`).

**Supported Expand Values:**

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| product.Promotions | Includes active promotions applied to the wish list products. |
| inventory | Includes inventory availability details for each wish list product. |
| pricing | Includes pricing details for each wish list product. |
| addons | Includes add-on product options available for each wish list product. |
| productreviews | Includes customer reviews for each wish list product. |

**Allowed values:** `product.Promotions`, `inventory`, `pricing`, `addons`, `productreviews`

**Example:**
- `["product.Promotions", "inventory", "pricing"]`

---

get.summary: Retrieve PIM attribute groups
get.description:
Retrieves a paginated list of PIM attribute groups. Each group includes associated attribute family identifiers as an integer array (`PimAttributeFamilyIds`), group code, locale information, nested attributes, and other group details.

---

### Authorization

Requires a valid `Authorization` header (Basic or Bearer token), consistent with other Customer V2 APIs.

---

### Filter Support

**Filter Format:**  
`filter={Field}~{Operator}~{Value}`

Note: String filter values (`GroupCode`, `localeCode`) must be enclosed in single quotes. Numeric `LocaleId` values must not be quoted. For between (`bw`) values that contain a comma, use the comma replacer `^` (configured as `ZnodeCommaReplacer`).

**Supported Filter Fields & Operators:**

| Field | Supported Operators |
|-------|---------------------|
| GroupCode | eq, gt, ge, lt, le, ne, bw |
| localeCode | eq, cn, ew, sw, ne (resolved to LocaleId) |
| LocaleId | eq, gt, ge, lt, le, ne, bw, in |

**Examples:**
- `filter=localeCode~eq~'en-US'`
- `filter=LocaleId~eq~1`
- `filter=GroupCode~eq~'ProductInfo'`

For the full list of operators and usage examples, see [Filters, Pagination & Sorting](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-core-api-v2---internal/2ki8v7vm0qtpj-filters-pagination-and-sorting).

---

### Sort Support

**Format:** `sort={Field}~{asc|desc}`

**Supported Sort Fields:**

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| PimAttributeGroupId | Sort by the PIM attribute group identifier. |
| localeId | Sort by locale Id. |

**Example:**
- `sort=localeId~asc`
- `sort=PimAttributeGroupId~desc`

---

### Related APIs

- **`GET`** [List PIM attribute groups](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-core-api-v1---internal/xwe3j0721y15-list-pim-attribute-groups)
- **`GET`** [Retrieve a PIM attribute group by ID](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-core-api-v1---internal/2qt3jt6n271w-retrieve-a-pim-attribute-group-by-id)
- **`POST`** [Create a PIM attribute group](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-core-api-v1---internal/62mwoivr1vru-create-a-pim-attribute-group )
- **`PUT`** [Update a PIM attribute group](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-core-api-v1---internal/kv69k5ykp6ak-update-a-pim-attribute-group)
- **`POST`** [Delete a PIM attribute group](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-core-api-v1---internal/nqi80gmh2ni8-delete-a-pim-attribute-group)

post.summary: Initiate an import process asynchronously
post.description:
Initiates an import process asynchronously for the specified import type and template name.

Accepts import data in binary or base64 format and creates an asynchronous import background process. Returns an import process log identifier that can be used to track the progress of the operation.

### Additional Properties by Import Type

| Import Type | Required Property | Example |
|---|---|---|
| Product | `FamilyCode` | `FamilyCode = "ProductFamily"` |
| Pricing | `PriceListCode` | `PriceListCode = "RetailPrice"` |
| Inventory | None | No additional properties required |
| Category | `FamilyCode` | `FamilyCode = "CategoryFamily"` |
| ZipCode | `CountryName` | `CountryName = "United States"` |
| ProductAttribute | None | No additional properties required |
| CategoryAssociation | None | No additional properties required |
| Customer | `StoreCode` | `StoreCode = "STORE1"` |
| CustomerAddress | None | No additional properties required |
| ProductAssociation | None | No additional properties required |
| SeoDetails | `StoreCode` | `StoreCode = "STORE1"` |
| Highlight | None | No additional properties required |
| AddonAssociation | None | No additional properties required |
| AttributeDefaultValue | None | No additional properties required |
| Voucher | None | No additional properties required |
| Account | `StoreCode` | `StoreCode = "STORE1"` |
| Synonyms | None | No additional properties required |
| CatalogCategoryAssociation | `CatalogCode` | `CatalogCode = "CATALOG1"` |
| Brands | None | No additional properties required |
| Promotions | `DiscountName` | `DiscountName = "Amount Off Product"` |
| SalesRep | None | No additional properties required |
| BStoreCustomer | None | No additional properties required |

---

StateName.description: Gets or sets the state name.

CityName.description: Gets or sets the city name.

PhoneNumber.description: Gets or sets the phone number, limited to a maximum length of 50 characters.

MobileNumber.description: Gets or sets the mobile number associated with the address.

AlternateMobileNumber.description: Gets or sets the alternate mobile number associated with the address.

IsDefaultBilling.description: Gets or sets a boolean indicating whether the address is the default billing address.

IsDefaultShipping.description: Gets or sets a boolean indicating whether the address is the default shipping address.

AccessPermissionCode.description: The permission code that defines the approval access level for the user. Use DNRA (Does Not Require Approval) if the user can place orders without needing approval from anyone. Use ARA (Approval Required Always) if the user must receive approval before placing any order. When ARA is selected, at least one approver must be included in the UserApprovers list. This field is required.

UserApprovers.description: The list of approvers to be associated with the user's approval permissions. Each entry identifies an approver who must review and approve the user's orders before they can be placed. This field is required when the access permission code is ARA (Approval Required Always). It can be left empty or omitted when the permission code is DNRA.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [DAM / Media Explorer](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/MediaManager/MediaManager/List?folderId=1&displayMode=List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to DAM, then select Media Explorer.
2. Locate the desired media item.
3. Note the MediaId value in the URL when viewing or editing the media item.

MediaPath.description: The resolved file path or URL of the media asset associated with the blog or news entry. This value is typically system-generated based on the MediaId and does not need to be provided manually.

CMSContentPagesId.description:
The unique identifier for the CMS content page associated with this blog or news entry.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Content / Content Page List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Content/ContentPageList)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [Content / Content Page List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Content/ContentPageList).
2. Edit the desired content page.
3. Check the browser URL and locate the `cmsContentPagesId` parameter value.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Content Pages](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757018-managing-content-pages)

BlogNewsType.description:
Specifies whether the entry is a blog post or a news article. Accepted values are `Blogs` or `News`.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Blog News List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/BlogNews/BlogNewsList)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [Blog News List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/BlogNews/BlogNewsList).
2. The Type column shows the entry type for each item.

IsBlogNewsActive.description: Set to true to mark the blog or news entry as active and visible on the storefront, or false to deactivate it.

IsAllowGuestComment.description: Set to true to allow guest users to post comments on this blog or news entry, or false to restrict commenting to registered users only.

ActivationDate.description: The date and time when the blog or news entry becomes visible on the storefront. Leave this empty to make the entry immediately available.

ExpirationDate.description: The date and time when the blog or news entry expires and is no longer visible on the storefront. Leave this empty if the entry should not expire.

BlogNewsCode.description:
A unique code that identifies this blog or news entry within the system.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Blog News List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/BlogNews/BlogNewsList)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [Blog News List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/BlogNews/BlogNewsList).
2. Manage the desired blog or news entry and locate the Code field.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Blogs and News](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000756991-managing-blogs-and-news)

PublishStateId.description: The unique identifier for the publish state of the blog or news entry. This value is system-managed and indicates whether the entry is in draft, preview, or published state.

BlogNewsLocaleId.description: The locale identifier specifically assigned to this blog or news entry for locale-specific content management. This value is system-managed.

BlogNewsTitle.description:
The title of the blog or news entry as displayed on the storefront.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Blog News List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/BlogNews/BlogNewsList)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to [Blog News List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/BlogNews/BlogNewsList).
2. The Page Title column shows the title for each entry.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Blogs and News](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000756991-managing-blogs-and-news)

BodyOverview.description: A brief summary or excerpt of the blog or news entry content. This is typically displayed as a preview on listing pages.
BodyOverview.example: Discover the latest summer fashion trends and how to style them for every occasion.

Tags.description:

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Blog News List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/BlogNews/BlogNewsList)

**How to Retrieve:**

AllowPriceSorting.description: Indicates whether price-based sorting is enabled for this catalog. Set to true to allow sorting products by price, or false to disable price sorting.

AttributeName.description: **Facet attribute display name** - The human-readable label for the facet filter shown on the storefront (e.g., `Color`, `Size`, `Brand`). System-generated.

IsHtmlTags.description: **HTML content flag** - Indicates whether the attribute value contains HTML markup that should be rendered as HTML rather than plain text. `true` = render as HTML. System-generated.

IsFacets.description: **Facet flag** - Indicates whether this attribute is used as a facet filter on the storefront category page. `true` = attribute appears in the filter panel. System-generated.

IsUseInSearch.description: **Search indexing flag** - Indicates whether this attribute value is included in the product search index. `true` = attribute is searchable. System-generated.

IsConfigurable.description: **Configurable attribute flag** - Indicates whether this attribute is used to define product variants/configurations (e.g., size or color for configurable products). System-generated.

IsPersonalizable.description: **Personalizable flag** - Indicates whether this attribute allows customer-entered personalization (e.g., custom text or engraving). `true` = customers can provide a value. System-generated.

IsCustomField.description: **Custom field flag** - Indicates whether this attribute is a merchant-defined custom field rather than a standard product attribute. System-generated.

IsSwatch.description: **Swatch indicator** - Indicates whether this attribute is rendered as a visual swatch (e.g., color swatch, image swatch) on the storefront. System-generated.

DisplayOrder.description: **Display order** - The numeric sort order for this attribute in the product detail display. Lower values appear first. System-generated.

SelectValues.description: **Selectable option values** - The list of available selectable values for this attribute, applicable when the attribute type is `SimpleSelect` or `MultiSelect`. System-generated.

ConfigurableAttribute.description: **Configurable variant options** - The list of configurable attribute variant options for this attribute, used to build variant selection controls on the storefront. System-generated.

Value.description: **Option value** - The display value of this selectable attribute option as shown on the storefront (e.g., `Red`, `Large`, `Cotton`). System-generated.

Code.description: **Option code** - The internal code identifying this selectable value (e.g., `red`, `lg`, `cotton`). System-generated.

SwatchText.description: **Swatch text** - The text label or hex color code used for the visual swatch representation of this option (e.g., `#FF0000` for a red color swatch). System-generated.

Path.description: **Swatch image path** - The URL path to the image used as the swatch for this attribute option. Applicable when the attribute uses image-based swatches. System-generated.

VariantSKU.description: **Variant SKU** - The Stock Keeping Unit code of the specific product variant associated with this attribute value, if applicable. System-generated.

ImagePath.description: **Variant image path** - The URL path to the product image representing this specific variant combination. System-generated.

SwatchText.description: **Swatch text** - The text or hex color code for the visual swatch of this configurable variant (e.g., `#FF0000`). System-generated.

DisplayOrder.description: **Display order** - The numeric sort order for this configurable option in the variant selector. Lower values appear first. System-generated.

This boolean setting determines whether products assigned to child categories should be inherited by their parent categories.

When enabled, products from child categories are displayed in all parent categories across the entire category hierarchy. When disabled, products are displayed only within their directly assigned categories.

Eg.,  "IsProductInheritanceEnabled": true

For more details, [Click here](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000756920-configuring-general-store-information#Enable-Inheritance-of-Child-Category-products-to-Parent-Category)

Znode.Engine.PIM.Model.StockNotification.description: The request model for submitting a back-in-stock notification request (v2.1). All fields are required. Unlike v2, this model accepts an `Email` field directly instead of a `UserName`.

ParentSKU.description:
The SKU of the parent (configurable/grouped) product that the variant belongs to. Must match an existing SKU in the published product catalog. Enter up to 255 characters. This field is required.

**Product Type Guidelines:**
- **Simple Product:** Use the SKU of the simple product
- **Configurable Product:** Use the SKU of the parent product
- **Grouped Product:** Use the parent product SKU

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [PIM / Products](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/PIM/Products/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to PIM, then select Products.
2. Locate the desired product in the list.
3. Note the SKU value shown in the product list or product detail form.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Products](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000756872-managing-products)

ProductSKU.description:
The SKU of the product variant the customer wants to be notified about. For configurable products, this represents a specific variant (e.g., a particular size or color). For simple products, this is the product itself. For grouped products, this is the child product SKU. Must match an existing SKU in the published product catalog. Enter up to 255 characters. This field is required.

**Product Type Guidelines:**
- **Simple Product:** Use the SKU of the simple product
- **Configurable Product:** Use the variant SKU (e.g., size/color specific SKU)
- **Grouped Product:** Use the child product SKU within the group

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [PIM / Products](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/PIM/Products/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to PIM, then select Products.
2. Locate the desired product in the list.
3. Note the SKU value shown in the product list or product detail form.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Products](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000756872-managing-products)

Email.description: The customer's email address to send the back-in-stock notification to. Must be a valid email address (for example, user@domain.com). This field is required.

Quantity.description: The number of units the customer wishes to be notified about when the product becomes available. Must be between 1 and 2,000,000,000 units. This field is required.

StoreCode.description:
The unique code identifying the storefront context for this notification request. Used internally to resolve the store identifier. This field is required.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Stores / Manage Stores](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/Store/List)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Go to Stores, then select Manage Stores.
2. Locate the desired store in the list.
3. Note the Store Code value shown in the Store Code column.

**Knowledgebase:** [Managing Stores](https://support.znode.com/support/solutions/articles/43000757163-managing-stores)

CatalogCode.description:
The unique code identifying the product catalog associated with the store. Used internally to resolve the catalog identifier. This field is required.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [PIM / Catalog](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/PIM/Catalog/CatalogList)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Go to PIM, then select Catalog.
2. Locate the desired catalog in the list.
3. Note the Catalog Code value shown in the catalog list.

SEODescription.description: SEO meta description tag for search engines. Typically 150-160 characters. Displayed in search engine results pages (SERPs) to help users understand the product. Only included when expand parameter includes 'Seo' or when flag 'Display Pricing and SEO Details from Index' is enabled.
SEODescription.example: Latest Apple iPhone 15 with advanced camera and A17 Bionic chip

SEOKeywords.description: SEO keywords for search engine optimization. Used by search engines to understand product content. Only included when expand parameter includes 'Seo' or when flag 'Display Pricing and SEO Details from Index' is enabled.

SEOTitle.description: SEO page title tag for search engines. Displayed as the main headline in search engine results pages (SERPs). Only included when expand parameter includes 'Seo' or when flag 'Display Pricing and SEO Details from Index' is enabled.

SEOUrl.description: SEO-friendly URL slug for the product detail page. Used in the browser URL path for better search engine optimization and user readability. Example: /products/apple-iphone-15. Only included when expand parameter includes 'Seo' or when flag 'Display Pricing and SEO Details from Index' is enabled.

SKU.description: Stock Keeping Unit identifier. Unique code for inventory tracking and order management. Used to identify specific product variants and manage stock levels. Example: IPH15-256GB for iPhone 15 with 256GB storage.

ImageLargePath.description: URL path to the large product image (typically 800x800 pixels or larger). Used for product detail pages. Contains the relative path from the media server. Example: /images/iphone15/large.jpg.

ImageMediumPath.description: URL path to the medium product image (typically 400x400 pixels). Used for product listings and category views. Contains the relative path from the media server. Example: /images/iphone15/medium.jpg.

ImageThumbNailPath.description: URL path to the thumbnail product image (typically 200x200 pixels). Used in search results and grid layouts. Contains the relative path from the media server. Example: /images/iphone15/thumb.jpg.

ImageSmallPath.description: URL path to the small product image (typically 100x100 pixels). Used in compact product listings and mobile views. Contains the relative path from the media server. Example: /images/iphone15/small.jpg.

ImageSmallThumbnailPath.description: URL path to the small thumbnail image (typically 80x80 pixels). Used in cart pages, mini product cards, and compact displays. Contains the relative path from the media server. Example: /images/iphone15/smallthumb.jpg.

InStockMessage.description: Customizable message displayed when the product is in stock. Typically indicates immediate availability. Example: 'In Stock', 'Available Now', 'Ready to Ship'. Useful for inventory status indication in the UI.

OutOfStockMessage.description: Customizable message displayed when the product is out of stock. Indicates product unavailability. Example: 'Out of Stock', 'Currently Unavailable', 'Sold Out'. Useful for inventory status indication in the UI.

BackOrderMessage.description: Customizable message displayed when the product is on backorder. Indicates when the product is expected to be available. Example: 'Ships in 2 weeks', 'Expected delivery: April 15', 'Pre-order available'. Null if product is not on backorder.

CategoryIds.description: List of all category IDs that this product is associated with. A product can belong to multiple categories for cross-category shopping experiences. Useful for building breadcrumb navigation and category hierarchies. Example: [1, 5, 8] means the product is in categories with IDs 1, 5, and 8.

SalesPrice.description: Current promotional or discounted price for the product. Applied when active promotions or discounts exist. Null or equal to RetailPrice if no discounts are active. Only included when expand parameter includes 'Pricing' or when flag 'Display Pricing and SEO Details from Index' is enabled.

RetailPrice.description: Regular selling price of the product without discounts or promotions. This is the standard price displayed to customers when no promotions are active. Only included when expand parameter includes 'Pricing' or when flag 'Display Pricing and SEO Details from Index' is enabled.

ProductPrice.description: Base or cost price of the product. Used for profit margin calculations and pricing strategy. May differ from retail price due to cost basis. Only included when expand parameter includes 'Pricing' or when flag 'Display Pricing and SEO Details from Index' is enabled.

Quantity.description: Available quantity of the product in the default warehouse. Represents current stock level. Null or 0 indicates out of stock. Used for inventory display and purchase availability checks.

Inventory.description: Product inventory across multiple warehouses. Each inventory item contains quantity, warehouse name, location, and backorder information.Useful for multi-warehouse inventory management and fulfillment decisions.

SwatchAttributesValues.description: Color or visual swatch attributes for products with visual variations. Contains swatch images or color codes for products like clothing or color-variant items. Used for visual product selection in the UI.

HighlightList.description: Product highlights or badges such as 'Best Seller', 'New Arrival', 'Featured Product', etc. Each highlight contains a name, code, and media path for the badge image. Used for visual product promotion in search results and product pages. Only included when expand parameter includes 'Highlights' or when flag 'Display Pricing and SEO Details from Index' is enabled.

SuggestTerm.description:
The primary or topmost Did you mean suggestion for the search.

**When Suggestions Appear:** Suggestions will only be generated if the Did You Mean feature has been enabled by the admin in the Search Index Settings. If this feature is disabled, no suggestions will be returned and the field may be null.

**How to Enable:**
1. Navigate to [SearchConfiguration/GetTabStructureSearchIndex](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/SearchConfiguration/GetTabStructureSearchIndex).
2. Navigate to PIM Index Settings.
3. Click **Edit** on the desired search index setting.
4. Enable the **Did You Mean (DYM)** option.
5. Once enabled, the top suggestion will be listed here.

IsSearchFromSuggestion.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the search is performed from a suggestion.

TotalCMSPageCount.description: The total count of CMS pages.

AssociatedCategoryIds.description: The list of associated category IDs.

DidYouMeanAlternatives.description:
Alternative 'Did You Mean' suggestions beyond the top result.

**When Suggestions Appear:** These alternatives will only be generated if the 'Did You Mean' feature has been enabled by the admin in the Search Index Settings. If disabled, no alternatives will be returned and the field may be null.

**How to Enable:**
1. Navigate to [SearchConfiguration/GetTabStructureSearchIndex](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/SearchConfiguration/GetTabStructureSearchIndex).
2. Click **Edit** on the desired search index setting.
3. Enable the **Did You Mean (DYM)** option.
4. Once enabled, additional suggestions beyond the top result will be listed here.

Set to true if the account should be treated as a guest account without full registration. Set to false for a fully registered customer account.

**Note**: When `IsGuestUser = true`, guest users are created using only the email address, and the username is ignored. As per the current implementation, multiple guest users can be created with the same email address.

When creating a guest user, several fields behave differently from a fully registered user:

- `AspNetUserId` is always returned as `null`.
- `Username` is ignored during user creation and is returned as `null` in the response.
- `RoleName` is always returned as `null` because guest users are not assigned any roles.
- `EmailOptIn` is always set to `false`. Any value provided for this field in the request is ignored.
- Any fields that depend on an ASP.NET Identity user or role assignment are not applicable to guest users and therefore remain `null` or retain their default values.

MethodName.description:
The name of the API method to be overridden. This identifies which method's execution will be redirected to the configured webhook endpoint. Enter up to 200 characters.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Method Override List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/ZnodeMethodOverride/MethodOverrideList)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to the [Method Override List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/ZnodeMethodOverride/MethodOverrideList).
2. The Method Name column in the list displays the configured value.

ModuleDisplayName.description:
The display name of the module that contains the method being overridden. This groups the override under the correct functional area of the platform. Enter up to 200 characters.

**Reference:** [List All Method Overrides](https://apidocs.znode.com/docs/znode-web-api/4767302447c60-list-all-method-overrides)

WebhookUrl.description:
The URL of the external webhook endpoint to be called when the overridden method is triggered. Must be a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL. Enter up to 1000 characters.

**Admin Sandbox URL:** [Method Override List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/ZnodeMethodOverride/MethodOverrideList)

**How to Retrieve:**
1. Navigate to the [Method Override List](https://admin-z10-sandbox.znodestore.com/ZnodeMethodOverride/MethodOverrideList).
2. The Webhook URL column in the list displays the configured value.

IsActive.description: Set to true to activate this method override so the webhook is called whenever the method is triggered, or false to disable it without deleting the configuration.

AuthorizationHeader.description: An optional authorization key or token included in the webhook request header to authenticate calls to the webhook endpoint. Leave blank if the webhook does not require authorization. Enter up to 1000 characters.

**How to Retrieve:**

IsActive.description: Set to true to enable this method override so the webhook triggers when the method is called, or false to disable it. This field is required.
